user.title: Connect to the MaBarak add-on
user.description: Enter the host and port of the MaBarak add-on. Normally the add-on announces itself and you do not need this screen — if you are here, find the add-on's real host name: open the add-on page and read the slug in your browser's address bar (.../hassio/addon/XXXXXXXX_mabarak/info), then type it with hyphens: XXXXXXXX-mabarak.

data_description.host: Add-on host name: its slug with hyphens instead of underscores. The prefix is a hash of the repository it came from, so the suggested value is only a template to correct.
data_description.port: Ingress port of the add-on. Default is 8099.

hassio_confirm.title: MaBarak add-on detected
hassio_confirm.description: Do you want to add {name} to Home Assistant? Its maintenance data will be exposed as sensors and a calendar.

error.cannot_connect: The add-on is unreachable. Check that it is started, then try again.
error.unsupported_version: The add-on version is not compatible with this integration. Update both together.
error.refused: The add-on answered but refused the connection. Update the add-on: versions before 0.30.1 did not allow Home Assistant to reach it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one MaBarak instance can be configured.

apercu.name: House overview
apercu.description: Returns the home's maintenance state: overdue items, upcoming due dates, expiring warranties, rooms and equipment count.

chercher_equipement.name: Search equipment
chercher_equipement.description: Searches equipment and returns full records, including maintenance items, frequency and next due date.

recherche.name: Search
recherche.description: Term matched against name, brand or model. Empty returns everything.

valider_entretien.name: Mark maintenance as done
valider_entretien.description: Records that a recurring maintenance was performed and computes its next due date.

entretien.name: Maintenance
entretien.description: Name of the maintenance performed, e.g. “chimney sweeping”.

equipement.name: Equipment
equipement.description: Name of the equipment. Only needed when the maintenance name is ambiguous.

fait_par.name: Performed by
fait_par.description: Who did it. Linked to a household member or provider when the name matches.

montant_euros.name: Amount
montant_euros.description: Cost of the maintenance, in the home's currency.

creer_entretien.name: Schedule maintenance
creer_entretien.description: Adds a recurring maintenance to an existing equipment. Only one way of expressing the frequency at a time.

nom.name: Name
nom.description: Name of the maintenance, e.g. “change the filter”.

tous_les.name: Every
tous_les.description: Number of units between two passes. Requires “Unit”.

chaque_annee_le.name: Every year on
chaque_annee_le.description: Fixed day and month, formatted DD-MM, e.g. 15-09.

le.name: On
le.description: Single date, for a one-off maintenance.

saison_du_mois.name: Season starts in month
saison_du_mois.description: Start of the seasonal window. Outside it, no due date is computed.

derniere_fois.name: Last done
derniere_fois.description: Date of the last pass, if known. Used to compute the first due date.

responsable.name: Assignee
responsable.description: Household member or provider in charge. Must exist in the directory.

creer_equipement.name: Create an equipment record
creer_equipement.description: Creates an equipment record. The location must already exist, unless creating it is explicitly requested.

nom.name: Name
nom.description: Name of the equipment, e.g. “washing machine”.

type.name: Type
type.description: An appliance, or a building element such as a roof or a facade.

creer_le_lieu.name: Create the location
creer_le_lieu.description: Create the room if missing. Without this, a misspelled name is refused rather than duplicated.

date_installation.name: Installation date
date_installation.description: Date it was put into service.

garantie_mois.name: Warranty
garantie_mois.description: Warranty duration in months. The end date is computed.

consigner_intervention.name: Log an intervention
consigner_intervention.description: Logs a one-off intervention — breakdown, repair, inspection — that matches no scheduled maintenance.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the intervention. Defaults to today.
